why: Restart of the tests step for pull request 1 of the anti-slop install, in next/ and tooling, from a fresh clone of the fork at 5360c123dfe89a20edab7b277099dd423247a8dd (a clone a stopped run left in the scratch folder was not reused). All 70 files of the fork's src/ were read. Every rule file is a pure syntax walk importing only @oxlint/plugins and its own helpers. One file is not: src/rules/require-readable-spacing-cli.test.ts, a test of theirs, spawns `pnpm exec oxlint` and writes temp files. The step stopped there as the brief said, and the lead said yes to committing src/ whole, since the owner ruled it comes in unchanged and nothing here runs it; law L6 now holds that. Laws: L1 vendored.test.ts, a property over generated src trees and edits (byte, add, remove, tree id), committed or not, 20 runs plus 10 pinned examples; L2 to L5 in anti-slop.test.ts through the real config: L2 seven taken rules fire on their refused line and not their taken line in a listed folder, L3 each refused line stays silent in an unlisted folder and the config's root names no plugin rule, L4 a property on the zero lock, 100 runs, L5 no plugin rule at off or warn; L6 vendored.test.ts, a property over generated paths under vendor/ plus every real file against vitest's projects, and every tsconfig project as `tsc --showConfig` resolves it. Each was green on the real code and red by its plant. Found on the way: `oxlint --print-config` leaves JS plugins' rules out of the root `rules`, and tsconfig.base.json, a base nothing compiles alone, resolves to every file of the repo. Spacing has no folder at zero, so it has no block yet. The config change needed a vendor/ link in seven temp-repo setups and one exam-paths snapshot row; every law kept.
